items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that suits dry, sensitive-looking skin and won't strip it.
A ceramide moisturizer to support a comfortable skin barrier and help with dryness.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides that gently shields skin and softly evens the look of visible redness.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 15% vitamin C serum and the 10% glycolic toner for now, because strong actives can make sensitive, easily flushed-looking skin feel more irritated. Since your redness is constant and bothers you, I'd suggest having a dermatologist look at it before adding anything stronger.
